# Golden device-protocol frames, checked by both the C# (server) and nanopb
# (firmware) tests. Every value here is a test value, never a real credential.
#
# Format: <direction> <name> <kind> <hex>
#   direction  d2s = DeviceToBackendEnvelope, b2d = BackendToDeviceEnvelope
#   kind       valid      decodes to the expected fields and re-encodes to the same bytes
#              ignored    decodes with no payload selected
#              truncated  fails to decode on both sides
#              bad_length nanopb fails to decode; C# decodes it, so the server must check
#                         the field against its nanopb limit: reject such a device frame,
#                         and never send such a server frame
#
# Each test keeps the expected field values for every name and fails if this file
# and its table disagree. See the wiki's Device Connection Protocol and
# Notification Delivery Protocol.

# connect: protocol_version 1, auth_secret = bytes 0x00..0x1F.
d2s connect valid 0A2408011220000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F
# An unknown payload field 15.
d2s unknown_payload ignored 7A020801
# connect with its last byte removed.
d2s connect_truncated truncated 0A2408011220000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E
# connect whose auth_secret is 33 bytes (exactly 32 required).
d2s connect_secret_long bad_length 0A2508011221000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F20
# connect whose auth_secret is 31 bytes (exactly 32 required).
d2s connect_secret_short bad_length 0A230801121F000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E

b2d paired valid 1200
# pairing_pending K7QF2M9X with 600 s left.
b2d pairing_pending valid 0A0D0A084B375146324D395810D804
b2d rejected_malformed_request valid 1A020801
b2d rejected_unsupported_version valid 1A020802
b2d rejected_credential_revoked valid 1A020803
b2d rejected_server_busy valid 1A020804
# An unknown payload field 15.
b2d unknown_payload ignored 7A020801
# pairing_pending with its last byte removed.
b2d pairing_pending_truncated truncated 0A0D0A084B375146324D395810D8
# pairing_pending whose code is 9 characters (limit 8).
b2d pairing_pending_code_long bad_length 0A0E0A094B375146324D39584110D804

# Notification delivery (#102).
# notification: id n-0001, NORMAL, source Mosaic, title "Test notification", no text,
# occurred_at 1793903400 (2026-11-05 18:30 UTC).
b2d notification valid 222B0A066E2D3030303110011A064D6F73616963221154657374206E6F74696669636174696F6E30A896B3D706
# notification with every string at its limit: id 63 x "I", HIGH, source 31 x "S",
# title 63 x "é" then "!" (127 UTF-8 bytes), text 1023 x "T", same occurred_at.
b2d notification_full valid 
# notification as above with no priority, which decodes as UNSPECIFIED.
b2d notification_no_priority valid 22290A066E2D303030311A064D6F73616963221154657374206E6F74696669636174696F6E30A896B3D706
# notification whose title is 128 bytes (limit 127).
b2d notification_title_long bad_length 
# notification with its last byte removed.
b2d notification_truncated truncated 222B0A066E2D3030303110011A064D6F73616963221154657374206E6F74696669636174696F6E30A896B3D7

# notification_receipt for n-0001 with each status, then an unknown status 7.
d2s receipt_stored valid 120A0A066E2D303030311001
d2s receipt_duplicate valid 120A0A066E2D303030311002
d2s receipt_invalid valid 120A0A066E2D303030311003
d2s receipt_unknown_status valid 120A0A066E2D303030311007
